approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if one is.

class_account_id.description: The share-capital account of the class the round issues.

instruments.description: The recorded SAFEs and notes converting at the round (listInstruments), each at its own terms over the shares issued before it (design D6).

investors.description: Each investor's money; RND-SHARE allots each the whole shares it buys.

name.description: What the scenario is called, to tell it from the others side by side.

on.description: The day the round would take effect: the cap table at the end of the day before it is the one it dilutes.

outcome.description: What it gives against today's books; left out when it cannot be worked out, with problems saying why.

pre_money.description: A pre-money valuation, divided by the shares fully diluted before the round (with a top-up before the money) and cut down to price_decimals [accountant to confirm what the terms count].

price.description: The price per share, in the base currency; or leave it out and give pre_money.

price_decimals.description: The decimals a price from pre_money is cut down to.

problems.description: Why the outcome cannot be worked out, such as an instrument converted since.

resolution_refs.description: The resolutions the round's issues will name: needed to ask for approval.
examples: Board resolution 5 Mar 2027; shareholders' resolution 5 Mar 2027

status.description: draft: changed freely; approved: its issues are drafted, and it changes no more.

top_up.description: Shares added to the option pool with the round; left out for none.

top_up_before.description: The top-up is before the money: it counts in the shares the pre-money valuation is of, so the existing holders bear it.

version.description: The version of its inputs; with its status it makes the ETag.
